integrity: Analytic proof and finite reproducibility checker provided; computational checks do not certify the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Classifies compact normalized hyponormality companion perturbations for finite first nonzero endpoint jet on classical Bergman space, not Toeplitz singular values, generalized radial measures, or all-order-flat symbols. Historical priority for regularly varying compact Jacobi spectral lemmas requires independent checking.
title: Boundary-jet Weyl laws for Bergman Toeplitz hyponormality companions
